title.narrative: Pillars III: Provision of integrated Food Security and WASH Assistance through a protection lens to 4,470 Persons in Zahle, and Digital Innovation enhancing AAP to 15000 Persons and 5 NGOs Nationwide

description.narrative:
ltpgtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family:"gtThe proposed area-based approach seeks to implement a comprehensive and integrated intervention targeting the most vulnerable and food insecure 4,470 Lebanese and refugees and persons of concern at direct protection risk in collective shelters within the Zahle district. The project promotes localization, it is co-designed and will be co-implemented by Farah Social Foundation (FSF) and Solidarités International (SI) and will incorporate a strong protection and gender approach by coordinating with key actors in the area. The objective of the intervention is to address immediate life-saving needs of the most vulnerable people affected by the Lebanese crisis, combining food assistance with nutrition and hygiene support, protection and gender mainstreaming being at the forefront of the intervention. The project will primarily focus on Bar Elias, Qabb Elias, Saadnayel, and Kfarzabad cadasters in Zahle district, designated vulnerable areas, selected after coordination with other Food Security actors to avoid duplication. The Food Security component will be achieved through adapted modalities that include cash-for-food, distribution of food parcels purchased from women-headed cooperatives, MSMEs and small-scale farmers, and provision of ready-to-eat meals prepared by women working in existing community kitchens. Distributions will be coupled with Menstrual Hygiene kits for women and girls at reproductive age, containing essential items for dignified menstrual and hygiene care. The project will also promote health-seeking and preventive actions in hygiene and nutrition. The response aims to strengthen coordination and referrals between protection, GBV, WASH and Food Security partners to ensure a holistic provision of assistance. lt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtltspan style="font-family:"gtFurthermore, the intervention aims to provide a tailored capacity-building plan for FSF. Based on an assessment exercise conducted by SI, the need to have an established functional MEAL and AAP department within FSF was flagged. SI will closely collaborate with FSF in delivering a series of sessions, focusing on specific MEAL and AAP subjects. Throughout the duration of the project, SI and FSF will continue to support each other, applying lessons learned and capitalizing on the knowledge gained.lt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="text-align:justify"gtltspan style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif"gtMoreover, crisis-affected populations face multiple barriers to accessing humanitarian assistance, expressing their needs, and alerting humanitarian actors about potential emergencies. This is prevalent among vulnerable groups, particularly women, and people with specific needs and disabilities, who are often lacking social capital, community network, and the ability to get adequate support. It is the responsibility of humanitarian actors to reduce such barriers, and to provide assistance in a safe and accountable manner. SI is committed to being accountable to affected communities, and this commitment is translated into efforts to ensure a two-way communication flow through multiple channels, to guarantee safe and fair access to services for all those in need who are not reached by traditional AAP channels. SI has developed the SOLIS Bot, the first humanitarian WhatsApp Chat Bot to offer users a wide range of services. The proposed intervention will build on the success of the LHF-funded pilot project and aims to improve the quality and efficiency of the response, with a specific focus on PSEAH, for 15,000 beneficiaries nationwide. SI will contribute to the broader humanitarian response and will enable an accountable, evidence-based and inclusive assistance by scaling up digital innovation and sharing best practices and lessons learnt with the broader humanitarian community, paying a particular attention to children and people with specific needs and disabilities, with the four organizations that were testing the tool in 2022-2023. As part of its localization strategy and accountability commitment, SI will introduce and operationalize the SOLIS Bot to FSF, enabling them to strengthen their AAP and PSEAH systems.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtlt/pgt
